notes: LENDING rate: what a lender earns. A borrower pays more, so these are a FLOOR on the cost of financing. OKX is not the venue this book trades on; it is used because it is the only deep PUBLIC series of its kind (Binance signed-only and undocumented depth, Bybit six months, Deribit no lending product). The venue floor is 2021-12-14, so the 2019-09..2021-12 stretch of the carry corpus has no financing data at any price.
